changelog: FIXED: Barcode scanner can't read printed sticker — SVG was being stretched by width:100% CSS
FIXED: Print CSS now uses max-width:100% instead of width:100% — barcode renders at natural size
IMPROVED: Barcode height increased from 50px to 60px for better scanning from angles
EAN-13 format confirmed as permanent standard — 13 digits with checksum, clear bars
